summary.text: Lucien Daigle is a Republican state representative who has represented Maine House District 1 since December 2024 and is the Republican candidate for Maine State Senate District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election. A dentist, he was born in Fort Kent, Maine.

paragraphs.text: Daigle was born in Fort Kent, Maine.
He earned a high school diploma from Fort Kent Community High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine at Orono in 1976, and a degree from Tufts University in 1980.
His career experience includes working as a dentist, and he has been affiliated with the National Ski Patrol.
Daigle assumed office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, succeeding Austin Theriault.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Maine State Senate District 1 on June 9, 2026, and did not appear on the Republican primary ballot for re-election to the House.
